description: This file defines the ProjectAdminAPI class, which extends Endpoint and implements CollectionEndpoint. It provides an API endpoint to list available employees for project administration within the OrangeHRM system, including methods for retrieving data with filtering, sorting, and pagination. It uses various traits, validators, and external API models to facilitate its operations.
